```yaml
name: sccache warmup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # midnight UTC

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write

jobs:
  warmup:
    name: Warm up sccache on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-arm64, windows-latest, macos-latest, macos-arm64]
    env:
      SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET: walrus-sccache
      SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET_LOCATION: us-west1
      SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}
      SCCACHE_READ_ONLY: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          rustup-components: rustc, cargo, rust-docs
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Install sccache
        run: |
          cargo install sccache
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Build debug (workspace)
        run: cargo build --workspace --features "walrus-service/backup"

      - name: Build release
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Show sccache stats
        run: sccache --show-stats

      - name: Notify on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            await github.rest.repos.createDispatchEvent({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              event_type: 'sccache-warmup-failure',
              client_payload: {
                status: 'failure',
                job: context.job,
                run_id: context.runId,
                run_url: context.runUrl
              }
            })
```
